corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Enhanced Proposal: Inventory Intelligence Platform for NordFrame Logistics

**Submitted by:** Fernglow Digital
**Project:** Warehouse Inventory Dashboard
**Client:** NordFrame Logistics GmbH

## Our Understanding
NordFrame operates 6 warehouses across Germany and Austria, currently tracked via spreadsheets and legacy systems. Our objective is to deliver a unified, real-time inventory dashboard without disrupting existing data infrastructure, schemas, or daily operations.

## Proposed Solution

### 1. Real-Time Dashboard
Live inventory levels across all 6 warehouses, continuously updated from your existing PostgreSQL database via a secure read-only connector — **zero migration or schema changes required.**

### 2. Low-Stock Alerts
Configurable per-item thresholds with automated email and SMS notifications dispatched immediately to responsible warehouse managers.

### 3. Role-Based Access Control
Strict role enforcement at the database query level (Row-Level Security) ensuring warehouse managers view only their respective site data while HQ staff enjoy comprehensive multi-site visibility.

### 4. Rollout & Onboarding Plan
| Step | Approach & Timeline |
|---|---|
| Pilot | 1 warehouse deployed in Weeks 1–10 (exceeding your 3-month target) |
| Validation & Training | 2 weeks of parallel running with legacy spreadsheets alongside staff training workshops |
| Phased Rollout | Remaining 5 warehouses integrated in 2 structured batches across Weeks 13–24 (meeting your 6-month target) |

### 5. Support & Maintenance (Year 1 Included)
- **Critical Issues (System Down):** 4-hour response time during CET business hours.
- **Minor Issues:** 3-business-day response time.
- Includes routine maintenance, security patches, and minor dashboard optimizations.

## Pricing
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Dashboard + PostgreSQL integration | €58,000 |
| Alerts & role-based access control | €14,000 |
| Rollout support & training (6 sites) | €12,000 |
| Year 1 support & maintenance | €18,000 |
| **Total Investment** | **€102,000** (Within stated budget of €80,000–€120,000) |

## Risks & Assumptions
- Assumes read access to the existing PostgreSQL database can be granted without production schema modifications; confirmed feasible based on preliminary scoping.
- Phased rollout assumes each warehouse designates one primary point-of-contact for structured onboarding sessions.
- Alert thresholds are initialized with standard defaults; fine-tuning per site may occur during the first 2–3 weeks post-launch.

## Why Fernglow
Fernglow Digital has successfully delivered identical real-time inventory visibility platforms for two major regional logistics operators in Germany and Austria over the past two years, both of which operate successfully in production today.
